about: Skills copied unchanged from the components' own repositories. Edit this file, then run: python3 tools/sync_upstream_skills.py. Never edit the copies under skills/<name>/ by hand: tests/skills.sh compares them with skills/upstream.lock.json.

sources.why: Ships inside the MCP server the kit installs, at the same version.
Exasol's agent skills. Pinned to a commit: exasol-pyexasol is newer than the v0.24.1 release.
dash-server's own guide to writing dashboards; it has no frontmatter, so the kit gives it one.

skills.name: exasol-dash
skills.description: Exasol's own guide (from the dash-server repository) to writing the Dash app itself for a dashboard hosted on dash-server — layout, callbacks, the queries behind each figure, and patching or reviewing an existing app. Use it with the dash-server skill, which covers installing, starting and registering the server.

not_taken.exasol-labs/exasol-json-tables skills/*: Written for developers of that repository (they open crates/ and tests/ there); the kit's json-tables skill covers using it.
not_taken.exasol-labs/exasol-agent-skills exasol-s: Installs Exasol Personal itself; in the kit, exakit installs and operates the database.
not_taken.exasol-labs/exasol-agent-skills exasol-n: Configure and open the connector by hand; the kit's notebooks connect through exakit.nb with no secret in a cell.
not_taken.exasol-labs/exasol-agent-skills exasol-i: Same subject as the mcp-server skills of the version the kit installs; one skill per subject.
not_taken.exasol-labs/exasol-agent-skills exasol: Routes to skills the kit does not ship (ITDE, SaaS, extensions).
not_taken.exasol/dbt-exasol, exasol/exasol-persona: Only skills for developing those repositories (openspec).
